notes.title: Like Growth? Check Out Beacon Patrol’s Upcoming Playtest!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Growth players,[/p][p]If you love relaxing strategy games with tile-laying, puzzle-y goodness (and we think you do), then we’ve got something cool to share from some fellow dev friends:[/p][p]🧭 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2273850/Beacon_Patrol/"]Beacon Patrol[/url] is getting ready to launch a brand-new [b]Playtest[/b]—and you can sign up [b]right now[/b] to be part of it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/43e751c02c608760310bf7585200d5c464d6084f.png"][/img][/p][h3]What’s Beacon Patrol?[/h3][p]It’s a cozy, strategic tile-laying game where you patrol the sea, place tiles to explore the coast, and uncover all kinds of surprises. Think [b]calm vibes, clever layouts, and careful planning[/b]—right up the alley of any Growth fan.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌊 What’s in the Playtest?[/h3][p]The upcoming Playtest (available [i]very soon[/i]) includes:[/p][list][*][p]🤝 [b]Local Multiplayer[/b] for [i]all[/i] game modes[/p][/*][*][p]🚢 [b]Exploration Mode[/b] with 4 unique ships[/p][/*][*][p]🎲 [b]Board Game Mode[/b] (no ships or shores)[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Creative Mode[/b] for freeform exploring and building[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re into relaxed solo sessions or want to team up with a friend, this Playtest adds a whole new layer to the experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Try the Demo + Sign Up[/h3][p]Want a sneak peek before the Playtest goes live?
🎮 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2273850/Beacon_Patrol/"]Try the Beacon Patrol Demo[/url] — then don’t hesitate to [b]sign up for the Playtest[/b] right on the store page.[/p][p]The developers would love your feedback—especially on the multiplayer experience—and your input will help shape where Beacon Patrol heads next![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for checking it out—and happy tile-laying, whether you’re building forests or navigating the open sea. 🌲🌊[/p][p][b]— The Growth Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Growth Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fellow nature lovers,

first of all thank you for all your feedback you sent along our way, this is very much appreciated! based on that, we prepared a small patch to tackle some issues.

Here's the changelog:

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would grant the player Point Of Interest Rewards when populating an empty Tile that was not immediately part of a Point Of Interest.
[*] Fixed an issue that would lead to Reed Tiles having invisible water while being marked as out of range for Animal Population.
[*] Fixed some Hills and Reed Tiles not playing their spawn animation.
[*] Fixed some Meadow Tile Rocks always being displayed like they were out of range for the Player.
[*] Fixed a typo in German localization.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added personal highscore display in Main Menu.
[*] Added more Controller Input Glyphs to some UI elements.
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support and keep up populating the world of Growth.

- the Voodoo Ducks

notes.title: Sending forest animals to reclaim the land in Growth is my dream come true
notes.notes:
It's no secret that I love Dorfromantik. It opened my eyes to the world of tile-based puzzler strategy games, and I've looked out for similar ones ever since. Thankfully for me, there's been a fair few riffs on Dorformantik's formula recently - a focus on nature, a soothing soundtrack, and some good old puzzling. Growth is one of these, and I'm hooked on the demo that's playable as part of Steam Next Fest. Taking place on a hexagonal grid, the aim is to uncover the map using a range of wildlife, fertilising the land in the process. Each tile you reveal gives you points, and you'll have to navigate around mountains, water, and special landmarks.

Read more

notes.title: Cozy hexagonal-grid soft-strategy puzzle game Growth will release in Summer!
notes.notes:
Today, we are happy to announce the cozy puzzle indie game [b]Growth[/b], which premiered exclusively, during the [i][b]Guerilla Collective showcase[/b][/i]. 
More details: https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/guerrilla-collective-mix-2023 

[b]Growth[/b] marks the debut of newly founded 2 people strong indie dev [i][b]VoodooDuck[/b][/i].

With [b]Growth[/b], enjoy a [b]simple, idyllic, and relaxed hexagonal-grid soft-strategy puzzle game[/b], where you will bring life to a world, with terraforming and wildlife.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300300/Growth/ 

[b]Growth[/b] will be released in [b]Summer 2023 for PC on Steam[/b] and is currently featured in the [b]Guerilla Collective 4 Steam Event[/b]!

[u][b]But that’s not all[/b][/u] - To shorten the time to [b]Growth[/b]’s release, a [b]free playable demo[/b] will be available during [b]Steam Next Fest June 19[/b]! Therefore, [b]wishlist[/b] the game now, to get notified about the latest news and updates, and when the demo will be released!
 
[h3]Watch the Trailer now on YouTube: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=51KAx8py1LI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Growth[/h3]
Growth is a cozy, hexagonal-grid based soft-strategy game. Explore and populate a procedurally generated world by utilizing unique abilities of animals. Growth blends the beauty of cozy exploration with challenging navigation around obstacles such as mountains and rivers to populate fertile soil, transforming barren landscapes into lush forests, meadows and more. Experience an unforgettable mix of discovery and strategy. Start growing your own idyllic landscape!
Explore and expand an ever-growing, procedurally generated map by cleverly connecting clusters of wildlife. Claim newfound clusters or points of interest to receive additional wildlife or in some cases special rewards. As you expand the landscape, you will discover new types of animals, providing unique abilities to overcome obstacles. Whether you're looking for a quick break from work or a relaxed puzzle session, Growths intuitive gameplay lets you explore a beautiful landscape, tile by tile. 

[h3]Features of Growth[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hexagonal-grid-based soft strategy gameplay blends puzzle elements for infinite replayability
[*] Campaign mode with randomly generated maps puts your problem-solving skills to the test
[*] Cozy and idyllic gameplay creates a truly relaxing vibe
[*] Seven different animals with unique abilities to expand your toolset for exploring
[*] Points of Interest captures are rewarded with new animal types and more
[*] Nine different tile types allow for beautifully crafted maps and flourishing landscapes

[/list]

notes.title: Growth is taking part in Earth Appreciation Festival
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Growth [/b]is taking part in [b] Earth Appreciation Festival [/b]on April 17th, World Earth Day![/h2]

The festival is a reminder of the human-made issues that our planet faces, including climate change, pollution, overpopulation, lack of sustainability, and conflicts.

As part of the festival, Steam is featuring post-apocalyptic games, which serve as a grim reminder of what could happen if we don't take action to protect our planet. But Earth Appreciation Festival is not just about doom and gloom. It's also about [b]celebrating [/b]the incredible [b]diversity [/b]of [b]life [/b]on our planet and finding ways to protect it.

That's where [b]Growth [/b]comes in. Our game celebrates the beauty of our planet and invites players to become stewards of nature. [b]Growth [/b]is the perfect game for anyone who wants to take a break from work or enjoy a relaxed puzzle session. It blends the beauty of[b] cozy exploration[/b] with challenging navigation puzzles. We hope that [b]Growth [/b]will inspire players to appreciate the beauty of the earth we all call home and are very proud to be part of the Earth Appreciation Festival. 

So, join us on [b]April 17th [/b]and let's appreciate Earth together with Growth!

As always, if you want to support a small Indie team, please don’t forget to [b]wishlist [/b][b]Growth [/b]on Steam, as this will help us a lot. 


~The Growth Devs
